basic_profile.bio: Based in Portland, Oregon, I am a tech enthusiast with a penchant for tinkering with gadgets and smart home devices. When I'm not working as a freelance graphic designer, I spend my time playing board games with friends or diving into DIY tech projects. I love discovering new and quirky gadgets, but I'm not a fan of overly complex setups. I'm usually online during the late evenings, and I'm currently single.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in graphic design, having worked in the industry for over 5 years. My interest in technology is largely self-taught, fueled by a natural curiosity and a love for smart home automation. I enjoy learning through online tutorials and community forums.
